first_frame_promise: Frame 0 opens directly on the half-inch cockroach sprinting into the two-penny (3.2 mm) door slot—zero logo or intro delay.

experiment.hypothesis: Macro close-up showing lifted claws + planted shin spines ('NO FEET') beside two pennies will deliver stronger CTR + first-30s retention than a broad hydraulic-press survival angle.
experiment.variable: Mechanism-specific footless propulsion hook + thumbnail ('NO FEET') vs generic toughness framing.
experiment.control: Same 7-chapter Monarch Cam 16:9 documentary pacing (~9.8 w/sent) established in Ant #01A V3.
experiment.expected_signal: Strong first-30s hold across the sub-second door-crack vanish and steady retention across Scene 04/05's rough-floor bet.
experiment.minimum_observation_window: First 7 days and >= 10,000 impressions in YouTube Studio before judging CTR.
experiment.next_action: Compare Studio CTR + 0:30 retention against Ant #01A V3; test Title T2 / Cover C2 only if CTR trails baseline after window.
